subject: Tufts Park Off-Leash Dog Pilot Ordinance
overview: The Council considered a pilot program for off-leash dogs at Tufts Park and debated management issues at Wright's Pond. They also approved significant funding for library renovations and rejected a municipal electricity aggregation plan.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Ordinance
items.summary: Approved recommendations from the CPA Ad Hoc Committee to be drafted into a formal ordinance by the City Solicitor.

items.title: Board of Appeals Use Variances
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a legal opinion on how the Board of Appeals is granting use variances given a 1980s-era vote to eliminate them.

items.title: Wright's Pond Management and Safety Standards
items.summary: Approved requests for information regarding recent closures and capacity limits at the pond. Following public testimony on conflicting safety mandates, the Council requested that the administration clarify the applicable safety standards and provide recent Park Commission minutes.

items.title: South Street Traffic Calming
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on planned raised crosswalks for South Street and a schedule for future traffic calming installations citywide.

items.title: Licensing and Ceremonial Recognitions
items.summary: Approved a restaurant license for Wingstop and several taxi operator licenses, and passed ceremonial resolutions recognizing employee retirements, student-athlete achievements, and the passing of a retired firefighter.

items.title: MWRA Lead Level Testing
items.summary: Approved a request for the MWRA to conduct updated lead testing in city water and provide remediation recommendations for any high levels detected.

items.title: Library Renovation Funding
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $135,000 for an owner’s project manager and architect to facilitate a state grant application for renovations to the Medford Public Library.

items.title: Site Remediation Contract Extension
items.summary: Authorized a contract extension for engineering firm Brown and Caldwell to complete environmental remediation and site closure activities at 448 High Street.

items.title: Tufts Park Off-Leash Dog Pilot Program
items.summary: Referred a proposed pilot ordinance allowing off-leash dogs at Tufts Park to the Parks Department for neighborhood notification and a future joint meeting. Residents and councilors debated the necessity of fencing, liability concerns, and the impact on existing park users.

items.title: Mobile Food Truck Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a comprehensive food truck ordinance to the Licensing Subcommittee while authorizing a temporary pilot program for specific summer and autumn community events.

items.title: Community Electricity Aggregation
items.summary: Defeated a proposal to authorize a municipal electricity aggregation program following concerns regarding the opt-out mechanism and financial guarantees for residents.

items.title: Assistant City Solicitor Pay Equity
items.summary: Approved the final reading of an ordinance reclassifying the Assistant City Solicitor position to ensure wage parity with other communities.

items.title: Main Street Bus Stop Relocation
items.summary: Discussed a proposal to move the bus stop on Main Street to Riverside Avenue; the motion was withdrawn pending further consultation with the disability community and the MBTA.
